runners_data.name: Alfred Wallace
runners_data.comment: Attractively bred, with his sire Dubawi and dam/granddam Group 1 winners for his owner
runners_data.spotlight: Attractively bred, with his sire Dubawi and dam/granddam Group 1 winners (predominantly over 1m) for his owner; mother's first offspring finished second last month on debut; likely to show major promise.

runners_data.name: Cuban Heels
runners_data.comment: 100,000gns yearling; by Havana Grey out of 1m 2yo winner; major stable; one to consider
runners_data.spotlight: 100,000gns yearling; by Havana Grey out of 1m 2yo winning (RPR 96) half-sister to 1m2f Group 3 scorer Sky Kingdom and daughter of NZ 1m Group 1 winner; major stable; one for the shortlist.

runners_data.name: Jaijai

runners_data.spotlight: 70,000gns foal, 155,000gns yearling; Hello Youmzain half-brother to five winners, notably Lone Peak (French/Spanish 7f-1m including 2yo; RPR 93); dam French 1m3f-12.5f scorer (including Listed; 98); market informative.

runners_data.name: Keep Kicking On
runners_data.comment: 85,000euros yearling; Persian Force half-brother to three winners; check the betting
runners_data.spotlight: 25,000euros foal, 85,000euros yearling; Persian Force half-brother to three winners, notably Threebagsfull (5f/6f including 2yo/Qatar; RPR 92); dam unplaced 6f 2yo (63); check the betting.

runners_data.name: Night In Vegas
runners_data.comment: 60,000gns yearling; Lucky Vega half-brother to five winners; market helpful
runners_data.spotlight: 60,000gns yearling; Lucky Vega half-brother to five winners, notably Shepherds Way (Listed-placed 5f/6f including 2yo; RPR 95); dam unraced half-sister to 6f Group 1 winner Slade Power; market helpful.

runners_data.name: Romanza
runners_data.comment: 160,000gns yearling; by Frankel; yard has had a couple of 2yo debut scorers this term
runners_data.spotlight: 160,000gns yearling; by Frankel out of 4.5f-1m winner (including 2yo/Australian Group 1; RPR 110); yard's 2yo runners this term feature a couple of debut scorers (SPs 5-1 and 18-1); reasonably interesting.

runners_data.name: Thunder Home
runners_data.comment: Potentially the least forward, being the youngest contender (May foal)
runners_data.spotlight: Night Of Thunder half-brother to 6f-8.6f winner Commander Of Life (including 2yo; RPR 86), out of 7f AW 2yo scorer (81); potentially the least forward, being a May foal who is effectively the youngest contender.

runners_data.name: Trust Yourself
runners_data.comment: 62,000gns yearling; by Showcasing; others have stronger overall credentials
runners_data.spotlight: 42,000gns foal, 62,000gns yearling; by Showcasing out of 1m2f AW winning (RPR 94) half-sister to Listed scorers in Britain (7f) and Australia (1m4f); others have stronger-looking overall credentials.

runners_data.name: Victory Gold
runners_data.comment: First juvenile runner of the season for a yard that has a very good strike-rate with 2yos
runners_data.spotlight: Space Blues colt; dam French Listed-placed 1m3f/1m4f winner (RPR 100), half-sister to Ebor/November Handicap winner Litigant; first juvenile runner of the season for a stable that has a very good strike-rate with 2yos, latterly 3-5 with sole individual representative in 2025; much respected.

runners_data.name: King Of Montenegro
runners_data.comment: May put his Bath experience to good use but sets only an ordinary standard on that form
runners_data.spotlight: Presents a slight dilemma as he may put his Bath experience (5.7f, firm; fifth of seven) to good use but sets only an ordinary standard on that form, progress pending.

races.name: Peroni Nastro Azzurro 0.0% British EBF Fillies' Handicap

runners_data.name: Deedaydiva
runners_data.note: Prominent runner facing congestion issues with useful Sandown form but needs luck in the tactical battle
runners_data.comment: Just 3 runs; Sandown 7f win was good form; satisfactory return in April; handicap debut
runners_data.spotlight: Just three runs but her Sandown win (7f, soft) on second start turned out very useful form with the second doing really well after and the next three also successful since; her comeback third in a Nottingham novice (about 1m, good) was perfectly satisfactory; interesting newcomer to handicaps.

runners_data.name: Electrifarhh
runners_data.note: Promising prominent type returning from 42-day break with solid Windsor form behind subsequent winner
runners_data.comment: AW winner at 1m as 2yo; just 2 runs since, tough tasks each time; improve for return to 1m
runners_data.spotlight: Won on second and final 2yo start (1m, AW); seen only twice since but had a very tough task in attempting to give weight to a subsequent big improver at Windsor (1m, good to firm) last May and wasn't seen to best advantage over 7f on Kempton AW in March; could well play a part back at 1m.

runners_data.name: Zgharta
runners_data.note: Hold-up specialist with strong Sandringham fifth form, benefits from uncontested pace but needs clean run
runners_data.comment: Has won at 1m2f but a stiff 1m can suit and this mark isn't beyond her; can go well
runners_data.spotlight: Off the mark in 1m2f Newmarket maiden last May; the Sandringham over C&D last June was a brutal start to her handicap career but a strong-finishing fifth of 12 at Glorious Goodwood (1m, good) next time, when blocked in her run, suggested this mark was within reach; had excuses on last two starts and has a big run in her under favourable conditions.

runners_data.name: Quamby
runners_data.note: Prominent runner lacking a win but showed late pace at Lingfield, trainer has poor recent strike rate
runners_data.comment: Lightly raced maiden; good handicap debut over 1m2f on AW in December; tricky again
runners_data.spotlight: Sparingly raced since 2yo debut and not yet off the mark but she put in a spirited late dash in a valuable fillies' handicap on Lingfield AW (1m2f) in December, close behind the winner who was ahead of her mark; acts just as well on turf but has other unexposed types to contend with today.

runners_data.name: Radiant Beauty
runners_data.note: Free-running prominent type in good 2025 form, tactical position crucial with races-freely tendency
runners_data.comment: Progressive in 2025, latterly for this yard; pleasing return in AW Listed race; solid
runners_data.spotlight: Progressive in 2025, coming right away for a 1m Redcar win on yard debut before following up on Kempton AW (7f); races freely and saw too much daylight at Newmarket (1m, good) in October but, hanging on well for third, she lost nothing in defeat; up against it in a Listed AW race at Kempton in March but it was a good return; has another handicap in her.

runners_data.name: Alobayyah
runners_data.note: Lone front-runner returning from 207-day layoff, massive tactical advantage if handling the break
runners_data.comment: Impressive 2yo debut; two runs in 2025, highly tried then disappointing; handicap debut
runners_data.spotlight: Outclassed rivals on sole 2yo start, over 1m at Yarmouth (soft); had a much stiffer task when returning in a Group 3 last August, where she was struck into, but she was nowhere near justifying short odds on Newcastle AW (1m2f) in October; goes handicapping with potential but queries.

runners_data.name: Song N Dance
runners_data.note: In-form prominent runner ending 2025 strongly, recent Leicester and handicap debut wins impressive
runners_data.comment: Lightly raced 4yo; progressive at 7f and 1m on turf and AW; has more to come; major player
runners_data.spotlight: Limited action so far but she ended 2025 in fine fettle, finding plenty to win a 7f Leicester novice (good) and was not at all hard pressed to win on handicap debut at Newcastle (1m, AW); useful comeback run when runner-up on Southwell AW in April and should come on for the outing; further improvement likely.

runners_data.name: Jannas Journey
runners_data.note: Hold-up type with excellent 2024 record but poor recent form, needs pace collapse to feature
runners_data.comment: Had a season to dream of in 2025, winning 7; still 4lb higher than the latest in September
runners_data.spotlight: Scottish yard won a Group 1 at Royal Ascot from just two course runners in 2025; this one had a season to dream of last year, winning seven at 6f-1m, but only once at the latter trip; this stiff track will test her and she's 4lb higher than the latest win in September; tall order.

runners_data.name: Bella Perla
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner better on all-weather, sole turf run disappointing but 169-day break concerns
runners_data.comment: Better for step up to 1m on AW in 2025, winning two of three; might need this for new yard
runners_data.spotlight: No impact in sole turf start for the Crisfords, on handicap debut last September, but she fared much better over 1m on AW since, winning two of her last three starts; subsequently sold for 35,000gns; this may be needed.

runners_data.name: Politely
runners_data.note: Hold-up specialist transformed by step up to mile on all-weather, significant weight advantage at 3yo
runners_data.comment: Progressive since upped to 1m on AW; up 6lb for ready handicap debut win; can rise further
runners_data.spotlight: Complete turnaround on two modest turf runs when upped to about 1m on AW, well clear at Lingfield then winning with something to spare on handicap debut at Wolverhampton recently; up 6lb but she can rise further.

races.paceDynamic: Alobayyah will set the pace from the front without pressure, creating a sustainable rhythm that should see her stay prominent throughout. Four horses (Deedaydiva, Electrifarhh, Radiant Beauty, Song N Dance) will jostle for prominent positions behind the leader, creating congestion and potential traffic problems entering the straight. The hold-up contingent (Zgharta, Jannas Journey, Bella Perla, Politely) will need luck in running as the prominent group compresses. This setup strongly favours the lone front-runner Alobayyah and any hold-up horses that can secure clean passages late.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Alobayyah maintains her lead and the prominent group gets bunched up 2-3 furlongs out
scenarios.body: The uncontested leader capitalizes on her tactical advantage while the congested prominent group struggles for racing room. Hold-up horses with clear runs can pick up the pieces but may lack time to catch the winner.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Group Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If the four prominent runners interfere with each other in a scramble for position
scenarios.body: The pace becomes messy with multiple horses trying to press forward simultaneously, creating ideal conditions for closers. Patient tactics from the rear prove decisive as the early pace crumbles.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Late Surge Success
scenarios.trigger: If Zgharta or another hold-up horse gets a dream run through the field
scenarios.body: The higher-rated closers utilize their class advantage with perfectly timed runs from off the pace. The sustainable early gallop sets up perfectly for their finishing kicks.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Prominent Breaks Clear
scenarios.trigger: If Song N Dance or Radiant Beauty escapes the congestion and presses Alobayyah
scenarios.body: One of the in-form prominent runners finds racing room and kicks clear of the pack with sustained pressure. Their recent winning form proves decisive in a tactical battle.

watchPoints.text: Alobayyah's 207-day absence could leave her vulnerable despite tactical advantage if fitness is lacking
The four prominent runners creating a mid-race bottleneck that could compromise their chances 2-3 furlongs out
Zgharta's ability to secure racing room from her hold-up position given the likely pace congestion ahead
Song N Dance and Radiant Beauty both race freely which could see them get involved in the prominent pile-up
Politely carrying just 122lbs as the only 3yo against older fillies gives her a significant weight edge

races.name: Carey Group Victoria Cup (Heritage Handicap)

runners_data.name: Houquetot
runners_data.note: Hold-up style with good trainer strike-rate but needs to prove he retains full ability after winter campaigns
runners_data.comment: Needs to prove he retains full ability; makes debut for another new stable

runners_data.name: Jumby
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner on three-year losing spell but has shown useful form in this grade recently
runners_data.comment: On a long losing spell and has failed to shine in the last two runnings of this contest

runners_data.name: Defence Minister
runners_data.note: Hold-up type who justified favouritism on seasonal debut and has low-mileage appeal as improving 4yo

runners_data.name: Mudbir
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse returning from 259-day absence but has winning Goodwood form at this trip

runners_data.spotlight: Well-bred colt whose record of 3-6 overall and 2-3 in handicaps (7f) features a narrow win at Glorious Goodwood; hindered by traffic issues at same venue when last seen (effort best forgiven); cheekpieces worn that day are retained; beat Defence Minister by half a length at Sandown last July; still open to further progress and remains of strong interest.

runners_data.name: Ten Pounds
runners_data.note: Prominent runner who raced too freely in this race last year but represents in-form South African trainer

runners_data.name: Nikovo
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse who remains unproven on turf with all recent wins coming on Newcastle all-weather
runners_data.comment: Came up well short back on turf last time; remains on a difficult mark in this sphere

runners_data.name: Hickory
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner with excellent Ascot record including fourth in this race last year

runners_data.name: Popmaster

runners_data.name: Jordan Electrics

runners_data.name: Tribal Chief

runners_data.spotlight: Effective on turf but still has a better strike-rate on AW and ended his rather truncated 2025 campaign with defeats (admittedly not entirely disgraced) in major handicaps over this C&D, finishing sixth then ninth; needs to raise his game on reappearance.

runners_data.name: Great Acclaim

runners_data.name: Pellitory

runners_data.name: Nostrum
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner who hasn't won since 2022 and showed poor recent form

runners_data.name: Shiplake
runners_data.note: Prominent type who impressed in last two all-weather starts for new yard and has 2-4 record over 7f
runners_data.comment: Impressed at Southwell (AW) the last twice; interesting assuming he's as good back on turf
runners_data.spotlight: Has form figures of 62743 on turf, mostly over 6f; impressed at Southwell in last two appearances, taking record for new yard to 2-3, strike-rate over 7f to 2-4 and AW score to 3-5; interesting contender, assuming he can transfer the progress back to this sphere.

runners_data.name: Shafdar

runners_data.spotlight: Low-mileage 4yo who is 2-5, all at about 1m on AW/turf, this year for new stable; prevailed at Epsom (good) returned to this sphere most recently, despite taking a good hold; may settle better and show further progress in this big-field scenario over a stiff 7f; not ruled out.

runners_data.name: Serengeti
runners_data.note: Prominent runner who has been inconsistent for three different yards since leaving Ballydoyle

runners_data.name: Royal Zabeel
runners_data.note: Prominent type who ties in with Golden Mind on Musselburgh form but faces stiffer assignment here

runners_data.name: Morte Point

runners_data.comment: Record of 3-5 since upped to 7f; reappearance effort is excusable; may do better still
runners_data.spotlight: Has form figures of 12110 (turf/AW) since upped to 7f, the most recent effort perhaps excusable as it was his seasonal debut and he raced a lot further back than usual; faces no easy task at this level but may resume his improvement with the reappearance under his belt.

races.paceDynamic: Golden Mind is the only confirmed front runner in this 29-runner handicap, likely to get an uncontested lead with prominent runners Ten Pounds, Great Acclaim, Khafiz and Jordan Electrics sitting just behind but unlikely to pressure the early pace. This sustainable tempo will allow the large field of hold-up horses to get into contention, creating a cavalry charge in the final two furlongs as runners fan out across Ascot's wide straight. The combination of one lone leader and 20+ hold-up horses in a large field strongly favours closers who can finish fast from off the pace.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Sustainable Pace Favours Closers
scenarios.trigger: If Golden Mind gets an easy lead and the pace stays moderate through halfway
scenarios.body: The large pack of hold-up horses will get perfect positioning to unleash late runs, with the wide Ascot straight allowing multiple horses to challenge simultaneously. Premium on finishing speed over early pace.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Runners Apply Pressure
scenarios.trigger: If Ten Pounds or Great Acclaim decide to press Golden Mind early
scenarios.body: A faster pace will stretch the field and favour horses with tactical speed who can sit prominent and quicken. Those too far back may struggle to make up the ground in time.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Golden Mind Wire-to-Wire
scenarios.trigger: If the front runner maintains a strong gallop and the closers leave their runs too late
scenarios.body: With 138lbs top weight but proven stamina, Golden Mind could exploit the tactical speed and sustain his effort to the line. The packed field behind may get in each other's way.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Into Sprint
scenarios.trigger: If Golden Mind goes too slow early and no prominent runner takes up the running
scenarios.body: The race becomes a 2-furlong dash where pure speed trumps stamina, suiting horses who have shown sprint pace over shorter trips. The 7f distance becomes academic.

watchPoints.text: Golden Mind must be monitored early to see if he can dictate terms uncontested or if prominent runners press him
Ten Pounds and Great Acclaim both need watching for tactical adjustments after previous racing-too-keen issues
The Wizard Of Eye returning after 187 days but has previous winning course form off this exact rating
Defence Minister and other lightly-raced 4yos could prove well-handicapped if building on recent improvement
Jordan Electrics stepping up in trip at age 10 after encouraging 7f debut suggests market confidence worth noting

runners_data.name: Hermetic
runners_data.note: Lightly raced with unknown going preference creates uncertainty, but Ian Williams' 4/30 strike-rate offers little confidence.

runners_data.name: Bulletin
runners_data.note: Hold-up style perfectly suited to expected pace scenario, with Hornby's tactical skills crucial from the back.
runners_data.comment: Very good second (Valedictory third) on 1m2f Newbury return; stays 1m4f; should go well
runners_data.spotlight: Both wins on AW but very good third (Valedictory second) of 14 to Rathgar (won again since) on 1m2f Newbury reappearance proves he's equally as effective on turf; stays 1m4f and likely to be in the shake-up again if in similar form.

runners_data.name: Kirchner
runners_data.note: Prominent style puts him in the danger zone for traffic, returning from 353 days off which compounds positioning risks.

runners_data.name: Classical Allusion
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner ideally placed for the race shape with Oisin Murphy's big-race experience a major tactical asset.
runners_data.comment: Promise over 1m4f on AW first two starts; too keen over 2m since; retains potential
runners_data.spotlight: Won Southwell maiden (1m4f, AW) on debut last autumn and best of the rest behind superstar hurdler Constitution Hill in Kempton novice (1m4f again) on his return in March; on the back of that he was sent off 11-10 favourite for his 2m Newbury handicap and turf debut three weeks ago but pulled too hard; retains potential back down in trip, but the outside stall has the potential to make life awkward.

runners_data.name: Too Soon
runners_data.note: Hold-up style suits but winless since 2024 form suggests he may lack the finishing kick required.
runners_data.comment: No win since 2024 and well beaten on reappearance
runners_data.spotlight: Largely in good nick last season but winless since 2024 and well held on 1m2f Doncaster reappearance (good to soft) six weeks ago.

runners_data.name: Valedictory
runners_data.note: Prominent runner who needs to avoid the early traffic congestion, with Gosden polish giving him tactical edge.
runners_data.comment: Big eyecatcher on 1m2f Newbury handicap debut; the one to beat up at 1m4f
runners_data.spotlight: All the rage in the betting but found the line coming just too soon for his strong finish when second (Bulletin close up in third) of 14 to Rathgar (won again since) on 1m2f Newbury handicap debut and reappearance three weeks ago; that first experience of a big-field handicap should aid his development and he left the strong impression 1m4f will suit; leading claims with further improvement highly.

runners_data.name: Serenity Blue
runners_data.note: Prominent style puts him in traffic danger zone despite returning to form last time at Kempton.
runners_data.comment: Two 1m2f turf novice wins at 3; solid third in 1m4f AW handicap on return; gelded after
runners_data.spotlight: Pair of 1m2f novice wins on good to firm at the start of last summer; disappointed in handicaps on final two starts last year but got his career back on track when third of nine in 1m4f Kempton handicap on reappearance 33 days ago; subsequently gelded; surprise if he's reached his limit after six starts.

runners_data.name: Siempre Arturo
runners_data.note: Hold-up style suits the pace but 162 days off and OR 94 suggests best days behind him.
runners_data.comment: Has healthy 8-22 record but below par at end of 2025 and might be best watched on return
runners_data.spotlight: The winner of eight of his 22 starts, the latest success coming at Kempton (1m4f) off a 2lb lower mark; ended 2025 with a couple of lesser runs and might be best watched on return.

runners_data.name: Gordon Grey
runners_data.note: Lone leader with uncontested advantage, in career-best form and perfectly placed tactically for this field size.
runners_data.comment: In career-best form last year; third in Bahrain latest but up against unexposed sorts now
runners_data.spotlight: In the form of his life when winning four in a row for Ben Brookhouse last summer, namely a maiden hurdle followed by three Flat handicaps over 1m2f and 1m4f (twice) on good/good to firm; better effort in Bahrain for George Baker this year when third of seven over 1m2f (good to firm) five weeks ago; returns to Britain on a career-high mark and may prove vulnerable to less-exposed sorts.

runners_data.name: Wine Dark Sea
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner who could benefit if pace collapses, but 211 days off raises fitness doubts.
runners_data.comment: Form of Newmarket second on final 3yo start was strongly boosted last weekend; player
runners_data.spotlight: Winning handicap debut at Kempton (1m4f, AW) last August; didn't fire in the same way back at Kempton (1m3f) next time but resumed his progression in no uncertain terms when close second in valuable 3yo handicap at Newmarket (1m4f, good) on final start, form which was strongly boosted last weekend by the winner (Yabher) and third (Daiquiri Bay); could have a big say if the betting suggests he's ready to roll after 211 days off.

runners_data.name: In The Breeze
runners_data.note: Hold-up style suits race shape perfectly, with recent Henrietta Knight stable transfer showing immediate improvement.
runners_data.comment: Winning start for Henrietta Knight at Thirsk last month but this is a much stronger race
runners_data.spotlight: Won at Pontefract (1m4f, good to soft) for Mick Appleby last September and bounced back from below-par efforts to end 2025 when making a successful start for the Henrietta Knight stable over 1m4f at Thirsk (good) four weeks ago; did that readily but this looks significantly tougher than that five-runner affair.

runners_data.name: Whatsgoingonmarvin
runners_data.note: Prominent runner facing traffic problems, returning from hurdles with fitness questions over 1m4f.
runners_data.comment: Bit disappointing over hurdles for this yard ahead of Flat return in headgear
runners_data.spotlight: A useful 1m5f Flat winner for Sir Mark Prescott last year; only fair form at best in four hurdle outings for this yard since, including when well-held sixth on Stratford handicap debut in that sphere four weeks ago; returns to the Flat with something to prove; first-time cheekpieces go on.

runners_data.name: Al Wasl Storm
runners_data.note: Prominent style risky in this field size but class edge from Group racing experience could prove decisive.
runners_data.comment: Resumed progression with 1m4f Newbury handicap win last August; more to come in 2026
runners_data.spotlight: Came up well short at Group level last summer but resumed his progression back in calmer waters with a 1m4f Newbury handicap debut success (good to firm) last August; this low-mileage sort has the potential for better again in 2026.

runners_data.name: Opportunity
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner with James Doyle booking suggesting strong Haggas confidence despite 323-day absence.
runners_data.comment: Unexposed handicap newcomer from top yard; market confidence could prove significant
runners_data.spotlight: Edged out St Leger runner-up Rahiebb in Haydock novice (11.6f, good) last spring; badly hampered when well-held fourth to Amiloc in a Listed race at Goodwood (1m3f) next time and not too hard to forgive a heavy defeat behind that same rival in the King Edward VII over C&D at the Royal meeting (good to firm); off since (gelded); a very interesting handicap newcomer, particularly if the betting speaks in his favour.

races.paceDynamic: Gordon Grey provides the only confirmed front-running threat in this 15-runner field, giving him an uncontested lead through the early stages at a sustainable gallop. The real danger develops behind as six horses (Boatswain, Kirchner, Valedictory, Serenity Blue, Al Wasl Storm, Whatsgoingonmarvin) all want prominent positions, creating a congested pack 2-3 lengths off the leader. This congestion will cause interference and positional compromises 2-3 furlongs out as they fan wide or get shuffled back. The race shape strongly favours hold-up horses who can avoid the prominent traffic and Gordon Grey if he can maintain his uncontested advantage.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Lone Leader Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Gordon Grey maintains his uncontested lead without pressure through halfway.
scenarios.body: The moderate early gallop allows him to conserve energy while the prominent pack behind squabbles for position, leaving him with enough in reserve to repel late challenges. His recent hat-trick form and tactical advantage prove decisive.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Heroes Strike
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent congestion causes significant interference turning for home.
scenarios.body: The pace quickens as the prominent runners fan out and jostle 2-3 furlongs out, perfectly setting up the race for closers with clear runs. Oisin Murphy and James Doyle navigate the traffic expertly on their hold-up mounts.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Survivor Emerges
scenarios.trigger: If one of the prominent runners secures an ideal position without traffic problems.
scenarios.body: Valedictory or Al Wasl Storm travel kindly just off the pace and find racing room when it matters, benefiting from their class edge over rivals. The Gosden/Burrows training gives them the tactical edge in the finish.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If Gordon Grey stops quickly and the prominent pack goes too slow early.
scenarios.body: The lack of genuine pace allows a midfield horse to make steady progress and exploit the tactical muddle. Wine Dark Sea or Hermetic benefit from the crawling gallop that negates early positioning.

watchPoints.text: Gordon Grey's early position is crucial - if he's pressured or goes too fast early, his advantage disappears completely.
The prominent pack of six horses will cause significant interference 2-3 furlongs out as they fan wide for racing room.
Classical Allusion and Opportunity both return from long breaks but hold-up styles mask fitness concerns better than prominent runners.
Valedictory needs Billy Loughnane to secure the ideal spot just behind the leader without getting trapped in the prominent congestion.
In The Breeze's recent stable transfer to Henrietta Knight and immediate improvement suggests he's primed for another bold showing.

races.name: Royal Ascot Local Schools Art Competition Handicap

runners_data.name: Enemy Agent
runners_data.note: Inexperienced hold-up runner facing tactical disadvantage with only two career starts and 28 days since last run
runners_data.comment: Beat useful sort on AW debut; only sixth next time but retains potential; cheekpieces on
runners_data.spotlight: In need of the experience but kept on well to collar the useful Generic close home on his 1m Kempton debut in March; only sixth to the same rival at Yarmouth (1m again) 17 days later but retains potential now handicapping; wears first-time cheekpieces.

runners_data.name: Sassicaia
runners_data.note: Progressive hold-up type with winning debut form but needs to overcome poor positioning against uncontested leader
runners_data.comment: Raced on AW; won on debut and better form when fourth since; likely improver in handicaps
runners_data.spotlight: Had plenty to do turning for home but picked up well to make a winning debut at Wolverhampton (8.5f, AW) in December; bettered that form when fourth under a penalty in a stronger race at Southwell (1m) four months later; his pedigree suggests he should benefit from this longer trip on handicap and turf debut; likely improver.

runners_data.name: Sintra
runners_data.note: Perfect tactical setup as sole front-runner with consistent RPR progression and 28-day freshening break
runners_data.comment: Promise in maiden/novice events and likely has more to offer in handicaps
runners_data.spotlight: Has advanced his RPR on all three starts in maiden/novice events, finishing 4l third to the useful Del Maro at Yarmouth (1m2f, good) four weeks ago; another in this line-up who likely has more to offer now moving into a handicap.

runners_data.name: Waterford Castle
runners_data.note: Highest RPR rating but hold-up style works against the likely race shape despite consistent placed efforts
runners_data.comment: Progressive when second all three runs for George Boughey; headgear on; leading claims
runners_data.spotlight: Now 0-6 but he's posted progressive RPRs when runner-up on all three starts since joining George Boughey; the form of his latest 1m2f Newmarket second has been boosted by subsequent wins for the third and fourth (the winner also a creditable third in a Listed race); if he can pull out only a little more for the addition of cheekpieces he could take a bit of stopping.

runners_data.name: Devil's Peak
runners_data.note: Six-race maiden whose hold-up style faces tactical challenge despite Gosden stable and 38-day break
runners_data.comment: Six-race maiden but looked unlucky on 1m3f Kempton reappearance.
runners_data.spotlight: Six-race maiden but he looked unlucky not to collect on his 1m3f Kempton reappearance in April, just failing have been denied a clear run; has looked a little ungainly on occasions but he's talented enough to win races.

races.paceDynamic: Sintra is the sole confirmed front-runner and will likely dictate terms from the start, with the other four runners all preferring hold-up tactics. This creates an uncontested lead scenario where Sintra can roll along at a comfortable tempo without early pressure. The lack of pace pressure means the leaders can conserve energy for a sustained finish, while the quartet of hold-up horses will need to rely on turn of foot from off the pace. This race shape strongly favours front-runners and prominent racers who can track Sintra closely, as the hold-up horses may struggle to make up ground against a horse with an uncontested advantage.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Leader Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Sintra gets an easy lead without early pressure from the hold-up brigade
scenarios.body: Sintra controls the fractions throughout and kicks clear in the straight while the hold-up horses struggle to close from too far back. His progressive profile and front-running style perfectly suits this tactical scenario.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Closer Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If one of the hold-up horses produces exceptional turn of foot despite the tactical disadvantage
scenarios.body: The pace becomes just moderate enough for a hold-up horse with superior class to overcome the positional deficit in the final furlong. Waterford Castle or Sassicaia most likely to benefit from superior RPR figures.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Prevails
scenarios.trigger: If a hold-up horse positions closer than usual to negate Sintra's tactical advantage
scenarios.body: One of the better-rated hold-up runners shadows Sintra throughout and uses superior finishing speed when the pace lifts. This requires tactical awareness from connections to break normal running patterns.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Finish
scenarios.trigger: If Sintra goes too fast early or the hold-up horses apply unexpected pressure
scenarios.body: The early pace becomes unsustainable and multiple horses finish strongly, turning it into a pure stamina test over the final two furlongs. The highest-rated closers would benefit most from this development.

watchPoints.text: Sintra getting an uncontested lead could prove decisive given the tactical mismatch against four hold-up runners
Watch for any of the hold-up horses positioning closer to the pace than their normal running style suggests
Waterford Castle's superior RPR rating could overcome tactical disadvantage if the pace becomes genuinely strong
Enemy Agent's inexperience and 28-day break makes him vulnerable in a tactically demanding scenario
Monitor early fractions to see if Sintra exploits his positional advantage or allows the field to stay in contention

races.name: Mariner Systems Fillies' Handicap

runners_data.name: Tryst
runners_data.note: Front-runner stepping up in trip after mixed recent form, could be vulnerable if pace gets too strong early
runners_data.comment: AW novice win; beaten at short odds twice since but retains potential now up in trip
runners_data.spotlight: Winner of an AW novice over the extended 1m at Wolverhampton last autumn; beaten at short odds on both starts since but recent handicap debut second back at Wolverhampton was creditable and she remains one who could have a bigger performance in her; steps up in trip for her return to turf.

runners_data.name: Bint Kilfrush
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with strong recent novice win, perfectly positioned if pace collapses but only two career starts
runners_data.comment: AW debut win; similar form when fifth on turf since; handicap debut
runners_data.spotlight: Justified short-priced favouritism in 1m novice at Southwell on New Year's Day; matched that RPR when fifth under a penalty at Yarmouth (1m2f, good) four weeks ago; the second and third haven't done much for that form since but she still brings unexposed potential to this handicap debut.

runners_data.name: Naga
runners_data.note: Prominent runner in hat-trick seeking form for top connections, well-suited to sit off the early pace battle
runners_data.comment: Completed a hat-trick on 1m2f reappearance and top yard won this race last year
runners_data.spotlight: Ended 2025 firmly on the up with a pair of 1m handicap wins last October and improved again to complete the hat-trick in 1m2f Doncaster handicap (good to firm) on reappearance a fortnight ago; raised 8lb but there should be more to come; leading stable won this with a 4yo in the Strawbridge silks last season.

runners_data.name: Lady Ridgewood
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse returning from 16-day break for new trainer, question marks over immediate fitness
runners_data.comment: AW maiden win last year but always behind on recent return for new yard
runners_data.spotlight: 1m2f AW maiden winner last August on her final start for Peter Chapple-Hyam but always behind in 1m3f Southwell handicap on her recent return for Ian Williams; can only be watched after that.

runners_data.name: Ruby Wedding
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse from top yard making handicap debut, lightweight could help but needs strong pace to aim at
runners_data.comment: Oaks entry is ambitious but suggests she's well regarded; interesting handicap newcomer
runners_data.spotlight: Isn't going to be up to justifying her Oaks entry but it suggests her top yard thinks a bit of her and she has to be of interest setting out in handicaps from a mark in the mid-70s.

runners_data.name: Moon Angel
runners_data.note: Prominent runner returning after 266-day absence, best watched on seasonal return despite past course form
runners_data.comment: Winner over 1m4f/1m6f last year but might be best watched down in trip on return
runners_data.spotlight: Second win for Stuart Williams when getting up on the line over 1m6f at Newmarket (good to firm) last August; not seen since, though, and possibly best watched racing short of 1m3f for the first time on her return.

runners_data.name: Venetia
runners_data.note: Front-runner stepping up in trip which should suit breeding, but 156-day layoff adds fitness concerns
runners_data.comment: Progressive over 1m last year and may be more to come handicapping up in trip
runners_data.spotlight: Progressive form in 1m maiden/novice events last year; good chance that trend may continue now handicapping over a longer trip which is bred to suit.

runners_data.name: Room Fourteen
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse wearing hood again after breakthrough handicap win 18 days ago, ideal pace scenario
runners_data.comment: Clear with a next-time-out winner on 1m2f handicap debut; definitely more to come
runners_data.spotlight: Big step forward when making a winning handicap debut at Yarmouth (1m2f, good to firm) in a first-time hood (retained) 18 days ago, edging out a next-time-out winner with the pair 3.5l clear; a 6lb rise may not stop her with further progress likely.

runners_data.name: Nanino Niyati
runners_data.note: Front-runner returning after 269-day break, fitness concerns make her vulnerable in pace battle
runners_data.comment: Turf novice winner but well held in handicap/Listed race final two starts; with a new yard
runners_data.spotlight: Won a fast-ground Salisbury novice over this trip for Kublers last summer; remote third in a soft-ground handicap and down the field in a Listed race on her final two outings last year; the betting is perhaps the best guide to expectations on return for new trainer (same owner).

races.paceDynamic: Tryst, Nanino Niyati and Venetia will all want to lead, creating a fierce early battle that should result in a strong gallop from the outset. The sustained pace over 1m2f will test stamina reserves, particularly with Tryst and Venetia both stepping up in trip under testing conditions. This demanding gallop will stretch the field and expose any weaknesses in staying power. The strong pace clearly favours hold-up horses like Bint Kilfrush, Lady Ridgewood and Room Fourteen who can sit off the early burn and deliver late.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Strong Pace Collapses Leaders
scenarios.trigger: If the three front-runners go too fast early and tie up in the final furlong
scenarios.body: The sustained battle between Tryst, Nanino Niyati and Venetia will empty their tanks, allowing the patient hold-up horses to sweep past them late. Room Fourteen and Bint Kilfrush are perfectly positioned to capitalize with their closing kicks.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Naga and Moon Angel can sit just off the pace and avoid the early speed duel
scenarios.body: These two can track the leaders without getting embroiled in the early battle, then use their class to strike in the final two furlongs. Naga's hat-trick seeking form and Moon Angel's course experience could prove decisive.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Runner Survives
scenarios.trigger: If one of the pace-setters can dictate terms and see off their rivals
scenarios.body: Tryst's recent good form or Venetia's step up in trip could allow one to break clear of their pace rivals and maintain the advantage. The winner would need to show superior stamina to the others who contested the early pace.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Tactical Pace Benefits All
scenarios.trigger: If the three leaders respect each other and settle into a more manageable rhythm
scenarios.body: A steadier early pace would neutralize the advantage of the hold-up horses and allow all running styles to have a chance. This would bring Ruby Wedding and Lady Ridgewood more into play alongside the pace angles.

watchPoints.text: Watch if Tryst, Nanino Niyati and Venetia fail to engage early, as this would completely change the race dynamic
Moon Angel's 266-day absence makes her hard to assess despite previous course form over similar distances
Room Fourteen's hood retention after her breakthrough win suggests connections expect another forward show
Ruby Wedding represents Andrew Balding who has strong 14-day form, making her handicap debut significant
Naga's hat-trick bid gives her strong momentum but prominent runners need the right pace scenario

races.name: Peroni Nastro Azzurro 0.0% Blue Handicap

runners_data.name: Juan Les Pins

runners_data.name: Cressida Wildes
runners_data.note: Hold-up style off 72-day break with claiming jockey facing traffic concerns
runners_data.comment: 5f AW win in February but absent since a lesser run ten days later; others more convincing

runners_data.name: Lord Roxby

runners_data.name: Fantasy Master

runners_data.comment: Ended 2025 with a Chelmsford win (6f; Class 5); up in grade and may prove vulnerable
runners_data.spotlight: Ended 2025 with a 6f win at Chelmsford in December; 2lb higher mark and stronger opposition might find him out back from five months off.

runners_data.name: Serenity Dream

runners_data.name: Twilight Jet
runners_data.note: Prominent runner past his best but capable if race pace suits
runners_data.comment: On the downgrade but handicapped accordingly; others bring stronger claims
runners_data.spotlight: Smart in his prime; not the same force now but the pick of his 6f form on turf and AW in 2025 would give him a good shout; others are safer all the same.

runners_data.name: Daring Legend

runners_data.name: Cajetan

runners_data.name: Waistcoat
runners_data.note: Hold-up type returning from 108-day break now tongue-tied

runners_data.spotlight: His two wins for Ross Burdon have come at a lower level; disappointed at Kempton when last seen and although he is relatively unexposed at 6f, he will need a clear personal best to take this after 108 days off.

runners_data.name: Dicko The Legend

runners_data.name: Hectic
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner back to last winning mark but faces stronger opposition

runners_data.name: Tokyo Joe
runners_data.note: Prominent type unexposed as sprinter returning from winter break
runners_data.comment: Two good runs since dropped to 6f; still has potential as a sprinter; shortlisted
runners_data.spotlight: Off the mark at the ninth attempt when winning a 6f novice at Lingfield (AW) in December; upped 4lb for that but he is unexposed as a sprinter and he makes more appeal than many.

runners_data.name: Thunderous Love

runners_data.name: Azure Zain
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse yet to win handicap off 87-day absence
runners_data.comment: Yet to win a handicap at he was well beaten on his seasonal return in February; not solid

runners_data.name: Rage Of Thunder
runners_data.note: Hold-up type with quirks but proven ability at this level

runners_data.spotlight: Not without his quirks but he has plenty of ability for one of his rating and everything clicked in a Class 6 handicap at Salisbury last June (6f, good to firm); three second placings followed and he should be sharper with last week's return to action under his belt; the start will remain a concern but he is not discounted back at 6f.

runners_data.name: The Bitter Moose
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner dropping back to 6f after 7f efforts
runners_data.comment: Made all for an easy win at Epsom (7f) last summer; fair return last month; needs more
runners_data.spotlight: Back to his best with a front-running 7f win at Epsom last August; creditable fourth to Arantes Nascimento on his return to action last month; not much room for manoeuvre off this mark and he is yet to win at 6f.

runners_data.name: Neyva's Angel
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with headgear now fitted after recent Southwell win
runners_data.comment: Finished behind Dicko The Legend at Southwell 10 days ago; Oisin Murphy a positive booking
runners_data.spotlight: Off the mark in a 6f handicap at Southwell last month; finished behind Dicko The Legend when fifth back at Southwell ten days ago; improvement essential but the booking of Oisin Murphy catches the eye.

races.paceDynamic: Lord Roxby will take the field along from the front with minimal pressure, joined potentially by Fantasy Master, True Promise, Twilight Jet and Tokyo Joe in the early positions. With 13 hold-up horses in the field, the pace will be steady rather than fierce, allowing the front group to dictate terms. The large contingent of hold-up runners will create congestion in behind as they seek racing room in the final two furlongs. This race shape strongly favors prominent runners who can avoid the traffic and hold-up horses with proven tactical speed to navigate the scramble.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Front Running
scenarios.trigger: If Lord Roxby gets an easy lead with minimal early pressure
scenarios.body: The pace becomes pedestrian allowing him to kick clear turning for home, while the mass of hold-up horses get caught in traffic behind. Prominent runners tracking the pace get first run on the leaders.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Traffic Nightmare
scenarios.trigger: If the 13 hold-up horses create a wall of traffic in the final furlong
scenarios.body: Racing room becomes premium with many fancied runners getting checked or having to switch multiple times. The few horses with early pace positions or those finding gaps prosper.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Sprint
scenarios.trigger: If multiple prominent runners engage Lord Roxby early creating honest fractions
scenarios.body: The early leaders come back to the field in the final furlong as the race becomes a sprint finish. Hold-up horses with tactical speed can time their runs perfectly.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Clean Sectional Battle
scenarios.trigger: If the field spreads across the track minimizing interference
scenarios.body: The race becomes a pure speed test with minimal traffic problems allowing each horse to show their true ability. Class and current form become the deciding factors.

watchPoints.text: Lord Roxby could steal this if getting uncontested lead with 13 hold-up horses behind him
Traffic problems inevitable with 13 hold-up runners in 19-horse field on straight Ascot track
Fantasy Master returning from 156-day break but Robert Cowell stable in form
Juan Les Pins has strong recent form but must overcome crowded field positioning
Multiple horses stepping up in class including Tokyo Joe and Neyva's Angel from recent wins
